name: logview-local
description: An expandable local browser console for Node.js logs. Install globally, use across projects without code changes.
author: mk-tdev

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:package
scripts.check: node --check bin/logview.cjs && node --check lib/server.cjs && node --check lib/capture.cjs && node --check lib/deliver.cjs && node --check lib/snapshot.cjs && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/preferences.js
